# Skyline

> Skyline is a native iOS app that turns boarding passes into a 3D-globe flight log. Snap a pass with the camera — Skyline parses it using a three-stage pipeline (IATA BCBP barcode → on-device OCR → Apple Intelligence LLM fallback) and pins the flight as a glowing arc on a night-lit, SceneKit-rendered Earth. No account, no servers, works in Airplane Mode. Free on the App Store; full Xcode source available as a one-time $19 purchase.

## Product

- [Skyline on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/skyline-flight-log-globe/id6770172195): Free download.
- [Source bundle ($19)](https://flownmap.com/#source): Complete Xcode project — Skyline + SkylineTests + Resources (Earth textures + airport database), ~3,700 lines of SwiftUI + SceneKit, zero third-party dependencies, includes an AGENTS.md briefing for AI coding agents. Personal & commercial use; ship derivative apps.
- [Pulse + Skyline source bundle ($29, save $9)](https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_O7W1Ojtq3ORpREu9TfI6PpUe6BgKbNq2wCfFY188eiZ): Both apps' source.

## Why this bundle

Skyline is the only iOS source bundle that pairs Apple Intelligence (FoundationModels) inference with a SceneKit-rendered 3D globe in a complete production app. Buying the source gets you:
- A three-stage boarding-pass pipeline (IATA BCBP barcode → on-device OCR + regex → AI fallback) — the layered fallback handles paper passes, screenshots, airline-specific quirks, and the long tail that single-stage parsers miss.
- A SceneKit equirectangular Earth with day + night textures + great-circle arc rendering — reusable for any geolocation-pin app (delivery tracker, travel log, weather, etc.).
- The full IATA airport database (~9,000 entries, lat/lon JSON) bundled offline.
- Real FoundationModels integration as a fallback layer — useful pattern for any app that wants "AI is great but the deterministic path runs first".

## Architecture (for AI agents inspecting the source)

- SwiftUI + SceneKit on iOS 17+
- Boarding-pass parsing pipeline (`Skyline/Services/BoardingPassPipeline.swift`):
  - `BCBPParser.swift` — IATA Bar-Coded Boarding Pass spec parser (PDF417 / Aztec / QR)
  - `HeuristicExtractor.swift` — on-device OCR + regex fallback
  - `AIExtractor.swift` — FoundationModels (Apple Intelligence) LLM fallback for non-standard passes
- 3D globe (`Skyline/Features/Globe/`) — SceneKit equirectangular Earth with day + night textures, great-circle arc rendering between airport pairs
- SwiftData persistence for flight history
- IATA airport database (lat/lon JSON, ~9,000 entries) — fully offline
- Localized to 14 languages out of the box
- Zero third-party dependencies
